title: Guard Clauses (when), Compound Guards & Silent Guard Failure
solutionExplanation: Enforces numerical bounds using when is_integer, when is_number, and safe division guards.

otpDocCards.description: Pure predicate assertions compiled into single-cycle CPU tests.
otpDocCards.complexityNote: Guards never trigger garbage collection and run directly in registers.

mentalModelCheck.question: What happens if an arithmetic exception (e.g. division by zero) occurs inside an Erlang guard clause?

options.label: The guard silently catches the exception, evaluates to false, and Erlang tests the next clause
options.explanation: In Erlang guards, exceptions never crash the process; they safely fail to false.

options.label: The entire BEAM emulator crashes with a core dump
options.explanation: The BEAM VM is fault-tolerant and isolates guard evaluations.

options.label: The process terminates immediately with {badarith, ...}
options.explanation: Expressions in function bodies crash with badarith, but inside guards they fail silently to false.
